segments.en: [Yiddish salutation:] "Peace with blessing, with success, with all good forever." [Hebrew:] (Peace and blessing and success and all good forever.) To the honored self of my dear and mighty friend, beloved to me as my soul and my heart — the delight of my heart and the apple of my eye — and all my aspiration, desire, and longing — the distinguished talmid chacham [Torah scholar], who fears Hashem with all his strength, and whose every aspiration is solely to serve Hashem in truth and wholeness — who drinks water from the well, the source of living waters of Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman [מננמ"ח] — the distinguished Torah scholar, our Master R' Alter Ben Tzion son of Nacha, may he live and be strong.
